theorems.description: Over full two-step cross-asset mulDivFloor sizing (p_d, p_c, haircut_c in [0, 9999] bps, mm_bps in [2, 10000]), adaptive bonus = min(mm_bps // 2, 250) never overflows and strictly improves borrower health (mm_drop > eff_drop).

When raw_seize > avail_coll, two-step floor back-calculation guarantees back_repay * p_d * (10000 + bonus) <= avail_coll * p_c * 10000 AND strictly bounds borrower rounding loss to < 2 rounding quanta.

Over UCPBA clearing price clear_p with buy_lim >= clear_p >= sell_lim, directional ceil/floor settlement guarantees 0 <= dust <= 1 wei, buy_pay >= sell_recv, exact IR on aligned fills, and strict <1 wei rounding bound on unaligned fills.

Over the full machine domain a,b in [0, 2^256-1], d in [1, 2^256-1] matching FullMath512.sol and clearing-core/math.rs, the guard (d > prod1) guarantees q_floor <= U256_MAX with q_floor*d <= a*b <= q_ceil*d, and the ceil carry guard (q_floor < U256_MAX when rem > 0) prevents U256 overflow.

Over a non-trivial 4-step transition (multi-decimal deposits, UCPBA ceil/floor dust, floored raw withdrawal, sweepDustToFeeVault/bad-debt dust confiscation, and floored fee sweep), physical vault reserves never underflow and strictly cover all remaining user claims + fee dust.

Over full BitVec(256) arithmetic for 6/8-decimal assets (received_raw in [1, 10^24]), repaySubQuantumDebt with transfer_from_checked strictly clears any sub-quantum negative balance to > 0 (and < 1 quantum for 1-unit transfers) without wraparound.
